journey.title: Professional Profile
journey.description1: Software Engineer with expertise in architecture and development of scalable, high-quality systems. Specialized in modern technologies for frontend (React, Next.js, TypeScript), backend (Node.js, Python, NestJS, FastAPI) and mobile (React Native, Expo).
journey.description2: Strong experience in building robust software architectures, scalable APIs, and efficient integrations, always following Clean Code, SOLID principles, and software engineering best practices. Expertise in deploying and maintaining applications in cloud environments (AWS, Azure, DigitalOcean).
journey.description3: Specialization in developing solutions with Generative Artificial Intelligence, including intelligent agents, RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation) systems, advanced chatbots, and data processing with LLMs.
journey.description4: Mastery of modern AI frameworks and tools: LangChain, LangGraph, LangSmith, OpenAI API, and natural language processing with Python.

services.question: What services do you offer?
services.answer: I specialize in software engineering, including frontend development (React.js, Next.js, TypeScript), backend development (Node.js, Python, NestJS, FastAPI), mobile development (React Native), cloud services (AWS, Azure, Digital Ocean), and Generative AI solutions (LLMs, RAG, AI Agents, LangChain).

process.question: What is your typical project process?
process.answer: My process typically includes requirements gathering, planning, design, development, testing, and deployment. I maintain clear communication throughout the project lifecycle.

freelance.question: Are you available for freelance work?
freelance.answer: Yes, I'm available for freelance projects. I can work on both short-term and long-term engagements, depending on the project requirements and timeline.

pricing.question: How do you handle project pricing?
pricing.answer: Project pricing depends on the scope, complexity, and timeline. I offer both fixed-price and hourly rate options. Contact me with your project details for a custom quote.
